title: An account changed preferences (OP-151 m.3 (i), IDP-37); the topics that changed are named, never their values
description: The member of the SET `events` claim, and of the CloudEvent `data.events`, under `urn:suiss:access:event:preference.changed`. A notification, never an authority source: losing or delaying it changes no decision (INV-24).

account.description: The account's opaque external id (OP-137): pseudonymous, never an identifier or a name.
